text:
Alice K: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for v2.4.1 — US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Canary in us-west-2 first. Ping ops and SRE for capacity checks.

Ben S: ACK. I'll watch capacity and thermal. Plan: 70 RPS canary, hold 10m, then ramp to 700 RPS region.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started canary us-west-2 slice-1 (v2.4.1) at 1716789012

Alice K: Running quick smoke. curl to health & simple generation.
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate -d '{"model":"rwood-7b","prompt":"health"}' | jq '.status'
```

deploy-bot: canary metrics (1m): errors=0.2%, p95=120ms, cpu=46% of pool, mem=54% -> health=green :white_check_mark:

SRE Oncall: headroom looks fine. pool us-west-2 has 62% spare GPU capacity. thermal stable. monitoring dashboards linked: https://dash.redwood.dev/d/us-west-2/canary

Maya R: FYI EU warmup note — eu-west-1 needs a short warm pool spin (2 extra nodes) to hit target p95 under steady 700 RPS. Recommend spin now, then start EU canary.

Ben S: Spinning 2 warm nodes in eu-west-1 now. ETA ~7m.

deploy-bot: us-west-2 ramp to 200 RPS (slice-1 -> slice-2) scheduled in 5m. ramp policy: linear 70->200 over 5m.

Alice K: smoke generation tests pass for slice-1. No regressions on structured output evals.

SRE Oncall: us-west-2 metrics after ramp (3m mark): errors=0.3%, p95=150ms, cpu=58%. Still green. Logging: no OOMs.

Release Manager: Rollback criteria (per runbook) reminder: error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 >500ms for 5m OR any OOM/crashloop -> immediate rollback to v2.4.0 and open incident. Pin critical customers automatically.

Carol P: Noted. I'll pre-create the pin list for EU customers that need forced v2.4.0 until we confirm all slices OK.

deploy-bot: eu-west-1 warm nodes up. canary hold pending signoff.

Ben S: Can we run a synthetic load against eu canary before cut? I'll kick a 5m 80RPS steady test now.

Alice K: go for it. I'll watch application-level errors and hallucination score for the eval set.

deploy-bot: eu-west-1 canary started (slice-1) at 1716789200

SRE Oncall: eu metrics 4m in: errors=0.45%, p95=300ms, cpu=68%, mem=62%. Warm nodes helping. No thermal alarms.

Maya R: Good. Suggest keep EU hold for 12m then ramp to 600 RPS if stable.

Ben S: Agree. I'll set ramp plan: 80 -> 250 -> 450 -> 600 across 3 increments.

deploy-bot: APAC hold: waiting for EU 12m stabilization and Release Manager signoff before starting ap-southeast-1 canary.

Release Manager: EU looks green to me. No noisy customers in the pinned list. Signoff to proceed to APAC in 10m. Keep the rollback gates live.

SRE Oncall: final pre-APAC check: global capacity headroom summary:
- US pool spare GPUs: 55%
- EU pool spare GPUs: 28% (after warmup)
- APAC pool spare GPUs: 40% (will reduce when canary runs)

Ben S: Launching APAC warm pool (+3 nodes) now. ETA 9m.

deploy-bot: ap-southeast-1 warm nodes ready. APAC canary scheduled in 10m at 1716789900.

Alice K: Quick note — release notes updated with the fallback behavior and changelog for v2.4.1. Link: https://confluence/redwood/releases/v2.4.1

Carol P: Pin list applied for critical EU customers. Ops will unpin after 1h of stability post-full rollout.

deploy-bot: ap-southeast-1 canary started (slice-1) at 1716789900

SRE Oncall: APAC 5m snapshot: errors=0.6%, p95=220ms, cpu=49%. All within thresholds.

Ben S: ramping APAC to 300 RPS over next 8m. watching for tail latency.

deploy-bot: APAC ramp succeeded. full region rollout scheduled after final 30m observation window.

Release Manager: Final check — everyone comfortable to continue full rollout? If any of the rollback criteria hit, call it immediately and ping #eng-oncall.

Alice K: I'm comfortable. Observability dashboards are clean. :thumbsup:

Maya R: LGTM. I'll keep a close eye on eval regression alerts.

SRE Oncall: standing by. If error spike >1% for 5min or any OOM, we'll trigger rollback and run revert playbook.

Ben S: Thanks all. I'll post a short summary when full rollout completes or if we need to abort.

deploy-bot: full rollout to US/EU/APAC completed at 1716790800. final status: green. :tada:

Alice K: Nice work team — will open a short post-rollout notes thread with metrics and any follow-ups.
